key_idea: Work backwards from the end, undoing one step at a time.
steps: At the end, Sam and Mia each have 8 stickers.
In the last step Mia doubled Sam's stickers. So before that Sam had 4, and Mia had 8 + 4 = 12.
In the first step Sam doubled Mia's stickers. So before that Mia had 6, and Sam had 4 + 6 = 10.

choice_feedback.A: If Sam had 6, Mia had 10. Sam can't give 10 stickers when he has only 6.
choice_feedback.B: If Sam had 8, Mia had 8. They would end with 0 and 16.
choice_feedback.D: If Sam had 12, Mia had 4. They would end with 16 and 0.
choice_feedback.E: If Sam had 14, Mia had 2. Mia can't give 12 stickers when she has only 4.
